verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own executive compensation and employee benefits page says it structures and drafts equity plans, advises on 409A, 162(m) and 280G issues, and secured an SEC no-action letter on pre-IPO RSUs. Its startup resources also cover putting equity vesting in place, so US-style option plans are well documented. Nothing in the pack describes non-US local schemes such as UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOPs, and the offices page lists only US locations. Missing for 10: any first-party description of UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP design; explicit stock-option-plan detail; independent corroboration.
